node.title: Empty Regex never fails but failed?
node.author: leszekdubiel
node.doctext: I am completely confused why this fails: printf "alfa\nwhatever" | perl -CSDA -n -e '// or die "not possible! -- $_ --"; /alfa/;' Die should never happen because empty pattern matches any text... Why? Why? Same on 5.24 and 5.26. Linux Debian. The code printf "alfa\nwhatever" | perl -CSDA -n -e '// or die "not possible! -- $_ --"; /al/;' also fails, but this one not (!!!!): printf "alfa\nwhatever" | perl -CSDA -n -e '// or die "not possible! -- $_ --"; /a/;'
